headline: 梵谷畫作亮相天價拍賣
context: 梵谷晚期畫作《開花的栗子樹》，估價約1.8億美元，將隨「近乎傳奇」的私人收藏一起拍賣。蘇富比公布的這批收藏含塞尚、雷諾瓦、莫內等畫家共12幅作品，預估整批拍出約4.5億美元，11月將在紐約開拍。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs, valued at $180m, to be auctioned along with 11 other works by likes of Cézanne and Monet For more than 50 years it was held in a private art collection with an “almost mythical status” that was likened to a miniature version of Paris’s Musée d’Orsay. But on Wednesday a painting by Vincent van Gogh created during the last two months of his life has gone on display before it is put up for auction with a value of $180m (£136m). Continue reading...
sources.title: Van Gogh goes on display before sale of ‘almost mythical’ private collection

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Sotheby's has revealed five paintings from Cézanne, Renoir, Monet and De Vlaminck as part of the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection, which is expected to fetch approximately $450m when it goes on sale in New York in November. The rest of the collection is being showcased digitally, including Vincent van Gogh’s Châtaigniers en fleurs. Most of the paintings were acquired in London in the 1970s by Carlos Pedro Blaquier and Nelly Blaquier de Arrieta. Continue reading...
sources.title: Five long-unseen paintings unveiled in ‘almost mythical’ sale of private collection – video

thread_text:
梵谷畫作亮相天價拍賣

梵谷晚期畫作《開花的栗子樹》，估價約1.8億美元，將隨「近乎傳奇」的私人收藏一起亮相。蘇富比公布的這批收藏含塞尚、雷諾瓦、莫內等畫家共12幅作品，預估整批拍出約4.5億美元，11月將在紐約開拍。

—— 本則來自衛報 2026 年 10 月 1 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

梵谷畫作亮相天價拍賣

梵谷晚期畫作《開花的栗子樹》，估價約1.8億美元，將隨「近乎傳奇」的私人收藏一起亮相。蘇富比公布的這批收藏含塞尚、雷諾瓦、莫內等畫家共12幅作品，預估整批拍出約4.5億美元，11月將在紐約開拍。

本則來自衛報於 2026 年 10 月 1 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 一幅梵谷晚期畫作要拍賣了，估價大約1.8億美元——換算大概是新台幣56億元。這幅《開花的栗子樹》，隨著一批「近乎傳奇」的私人收藏一起公開亮相。這批收藏還包含塞尚、雷諾瓦、莫內等畫家共12幅作品，預估整批能拍出約4.5億美元，11月會在紐約正式開拍。
